title: Term Life Insurance: Billing Installments That Fall Due While a Policy Is Lapsed
content:
**Premium accounting — Term Life Insurance.** Every installment that would have fallen due while a policy was lapsed is billed on the ledger as the back installment billed for reinstatement, at the premium in effect on its due date. Each such installment appears on the policy's activity history as a billed-installment entry for its due date and amount.

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| What is billed | an installment that would have fallen due while the policy was lapsed |
| At what premium | the premium in effect on its due date |
| Where it shows | the policy's activity history, as a billed installment |

## Invocation: `bill_back_installment_903386f9`

**Capability.** Bills one premium installment on one Ashgrove term policy's activity history: a billed-installment entry is added for the due date and amount supplied, dated today. Nothing else on the policy changes.

**How it is invoked.** Agent-side: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `term_policy_id` | The reference number of the term policy being billed, read from the term policy lookup before the call | Identifier, as recorded |
| `premium_due_date` | The due date of the installment being billed | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `billed_amount` | The installment amount billed | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more are given |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("installment_billed" on success), `billing_id` (the reference number of the new billed-installment entry), `term_policy_id`, `premium_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places). The new entry is visible in the policy's activity history.
